title: IQ-focused · Math explanation
prompt: Ask both models to explain how to solve three x plus five equals twenty, then ask how to check the answer.
questions: Can you explain how to solve three x plus five equals twenty?
How can I check my answer?
A: First, subtract five from both sides. That gives three x equals fifteen. Divide both sides by three, and x equals five.
Substitute five into the original equation. Three times five is fifteen. Add five to get twenty. The answer is correct.
B: The answer is five. Subtract five from twenty, and then divide the result by three.
You can check by substituting five back into the equation. It should equal twenty.
utility: Both explain the equation correctly. A provides a more complete verification, while B is shorter. Both meet the basic learning goal.

title: EQ-focused · Friendly tour guide
prompt: Pretend you are visiting a fictional town. Ask for a welcome and an invitation to return.
questions: I am visiting your little town for the first time. Can you welcome me as my tour guide?
What would you say to invite me to return?
A: Welcome to our little town! Let us take a walk through the market. After that, we can enjoy some snacks and visit the old clock tower.
Come back any time! There is always a new story to hear, a new snack to try, and a friendly face waiting for you.
B: Welcome! I can show you around the market and the old clock tower. You might enjoy the food here too.
You should visit us again. We have plenty of places to explore and lots of delicious food to try.
utility: Both stay in the tour-guide role. A gives a more vivid invitation in turn four, while B remains relevant. Judge vocal naturalness independently; these are synthetic voices.

title: IQ-focused · Tagalog study coach
prompt: Magtanong tungkol sa pagre-review para sa pagsusulit at kung paano magagamit ang maikling oras sa pag-aaral.
questions: Paano ako makakapag-review nang maayos para sa exam bukas?
Paano kung tatlumpung minuto lang ang oras ko?
A: Unahin ang mahihirap na paksa. Basahin ang mahahalagang konsepto, pagkatapos ay sagutan ang mga halimbawa nang hindi tumitingin sa notes.
Maglaan ng sampung minuto sa pagbabasa, labinlimang minuto sa pagsagot ng mga tanong, at limang minuto sa pagbalik sa mga mali.
B: Magbasa ka ng notes at subukang sagutan ang ilang halimbawa. Magpahinga rin kung kinakailangan.
Pumili ng pinakamahalagang paksa. Mag-review ka muna, pagkatapos ay subukan kung naaalala mo ang mga sagot.
utility: Both offer useful study advice. A gives a concrete thirty-minute schedule; B offers more general guidance. These are fictional scripts, not actual model outputs.
